missionStatement: OpenClaw is your always-on AI crew that keeps you ahead on AI and geopolitics intelligence, ships code reliably, and maintains perfect system health — with a professional, soothing, and fun personality that frees you to focus on building products, personal growth, and scaling your business.

projects.name: Otter Mission Control
projects.description: A Next.js localhost dashboard for live visibility and control over the OpenClaw crew, workspace files, schedules, memory, docs, team state, and GitHub activity.
projects.nextMove: Test Phase 4 GitHub integration: per-agent repository tracking, PR visibility, BuildOrder activity dashboard.

agentRepos.name: scoutorder-agent
agentRepos.description: Morning AI news scanner. Reddit, HackerNews, GitHub watchlists. Daily digest to Discord.

agentRepos.name: geoorder-agent
agentRepos.description: Geopolitics and Singapore-context scanner. Tracks hard/soft news, microeconomics.

agentRepos.name: buildorder-agent
agentRepos.description: Coding agent. Plans with Gemma4, implements with Qwen Coder. Fresh branches, Discord summaries.

agentRepos.name: healthorder-agent
agentRepos.description: Twice-daily health checker. Local model, zero cost. Silent unless failure.

crew.name: ScoutOrder
crew.mission: Scans Reddit, HackerNews, and GitHub, scores the content watchlist, and posts a daily digest to Discord.

crew.name: GeoOrder
crew.mission: Tracks geopolitics, microeconomics, and Singapore-context hard/soft news.

crew.name: BuildOrder
crew.mission: Plans with Gemma4, implements with Qwen Coder on fresh branches, and posts summaries to Discord for review.

crew.name: HealthOrder
crew.mission: Silent-by-default local-model health checker that only speaks up on failure.
